description: List the secrets stored in your Mnemoverse Vault — by ALIAS and purpose only; the secret VALUE is never returned or shown to you, and no tool on this server returns it. Use this to check WHICH secrets the user has stored and under what alias (e.g. the user says 'do I have a GitHub token saved?'). Only YOUR account's secrets are listed.
name: vault_list

alias.description: The secret's alias — the reference you use, never the value.

context.description: The secret's purpose/context — never the value.
